item.case_name: Intent test on the MCP (vague brief, proxy answers, paid calls gated): Trim a clip
item.title: Trim a clip
item.tests: does the MCP ask for what it cannot know, and does its attempted call match the user's answers (aspect, words, seconds, sound)?
must_haves: The attempted call matches the user's stated intent.

dialog.agent: How short should I make it, and is there a particular section you want to keep?

turns.agent:
The connected tools don’t support a trim-only export without regenerating the video. To keep just the first 6 seconds with FFmpeg:

```bash
ffmpeg -i v4-classroom-wipe.mp4 -t 6 -c:v libx264 -c:a aac classroom-first-6s.mp4
```
